headline: Anthropic targets $190-200B revenue by 2028 ahead of IPO filing
body: Anthropic is moving toward a public offering with aggressive revenue projections reaching $190-200 billion by 2028, building on reported Q2 2026 revenues exceeding $11.5 billion. For healthcare AI specifically, this signals major capital availability for clinical AI vendors and raises questions about whose solutions will scale into enterprise health systems. The company's focus on trust and safety as differentiators matters directly to healthcare deployment, where regulatory scrutiny and patient data protection determine adoption speed. Healthcare organizations evaluating AI infrastructure should monitor Anthropic's IPO trajectory and resulting product roadmap, as capitalization at this scale typically accelerates enterprise feature development and integration with EHR vendors.
